<thought>Combine the four subnetworks using the resistor values and connections that were provided. Subnet 1 supplies two resistors (R1 = 2.222 Ω, R2 = 4.445 Ω) linking A → N1 → X1. Subnet 2 is a single resistor of 5.0 Ω placed between X1 and X2. Subnet 3 contributes four resistors (R3 = 5 Ω, R4 = 10 Ω, R5 = 15 Ω, R6 = 20 Ω) linking X2 → N_c1 → N_c2 → N_c3 → X3. Subnet 4 adds three resistors (R7 = 10 Ω, R8 = 15 Ω, R9 = 20 Ω) linking X3 → N_d1 → N_d2 → B. All resistor identifiers are made unique across the whole network. The combined topology is expressed as a JSON object containing the resistor dictionary and the ordered list of connections.</thought>
